candidate_stream.world_seed_rule: sha256(world_seed_namespace + ':' + decimal_candidate_index), first 8 bytes big-endian, mask to 63 bits
candidate_stream.collision_exclusions: registered seed collision only; none occur in the frozen 0..1023 stream

private_target_and_public_motif_namespac.target_seed_rule: sha256(target_seed_namespace + ':target:' + decimal_world_seed), full 32-byte digest interpreted as one big-endian integer
private_target_and_public_motif_namespac.target_selection_rule: call existing generate_spark_world(world_seed, target_seed) exactly once; its existing random.Random(target_seed).randrange(256) selects the sole target

world_grid.motif_rule: existing SHA-256 _select_motif over world_seed, one-based slot_index, stratum, and motif_selection_namespace

endpoint.name: K4_full_pool
endpoint.replacement_pool: all structurally valid same-parent, same-frame, same-stratum, same-complexity matched replacements from the frozen motif library whose complete-domain behavior differs from the focal child
endpoint.model_hit_identity_for_future_use: exact action or identical full-pool counterfactual bundle; child semantic identity alone is insufficient

balanced_cohort.matching_graph: one bipartite graph from eligible worlds to K4_full_pool witness motif strata; every world has capacity 1 and every selected stratum has exact capacity q
balanced_cohort.unique_assignment_encoding: for each motif stratum in frozen order, sort its assigned candidate indices ascending, then concatenate the four lists
balanced_cohort.selection_rule: among every feasible exact-q joint b-matching choose the lexicographically smallest unique_assignment_encoding; never rank by action count, N_T, control-pool size, or model output

artifact_contract.interpretation_limit: constructs an outcome-conditioned finite DSL challenge set; does not test the hypothesis, estimate natural-world opportunity prevalence, change the sealed matched-triad result, establish model ranking, or imply human-unknown discovery
